body:
Does ASVS cover desktop apps? If so, should we recommend certificate pinning for level 3? I think this is something that the application and not the OS will have to handle.

However, I note that the introduction says:

> As of version 4.0, the ASVS will focus solely on being the leading web apps and service standard, covering traditional and modern application architecture, and agile security practices and DevSecOps culture.

comments.body: I also note that [10.3.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x18-V10-Malicious.md#v103-deployed-application-integrity-controls) refers to client auto-update which makes it sound like it is referring to a desktop app
I agree we should add it
Ok, any comments on my PR #671 or should I merge it?

9.1.4
> For thick client applications, verify that the app either uses its own certificate store, or pins the endpoint certificate or public key, and will not establish connections with endpoints that offer a different certificate or key, even if signed by a trusted CA.

Based on #803, is this requirement 9.1.4 still in scope?

If it stays in scope, it would be nice to rewording it the way, it starts with "Verify that" or "Verify" like all other requirements.
I think this is a good observation. My vote is that ASVS is really the WASVS - Web Security only. Mobile and Desktop should be in the MASVS. If we all agree with this I'll start suggesting PR's.

If we agree that this is web only, then I would drop pinning requirements. As on 4.0 and 5.0 the browser does not support pinning. It was removed but will come back likely in 3-4 years. 9.1.4 and 10.3.1 (and likely a few others) should go or be changed to be web only.
I definitely agree -- seems to me that the architectures are sufficiently divergent to need separate standards.
Since we agree desktop apps are out of scope and pinning is not part of the browser anymore, I am closing this out. Please re-open if I closed this in haste!

If we agreed that it is out of scope, why to close the issue and leave the requirement in standard? :)
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x17-V9-Communications.md#v91-client-communication-security

As Josh was setting it in, would like to get final confirmation from him as well.
Based on this thread and on #803 I think we need to remove the requirement

title: Add a cert pinning requirement (L3)?
